The description for the regex the Merge Request must adhere to

Use a custom instance-level project template, or a group-level one with `group_with_project_templates_id`. Premium and Ultimate only.
For group-level custom templates, ID of the group that serves as the template source. Leave empty for instance-level templates. Requires `use_custom_template` to be `true`. Premium and Ultimate only.
Namespace ID for the new project. Accepts a group or subgroup ID. Default to the user namespace.

URL from which the project is imported. When set, do not set `initialize_with_readme` to `true`, or the import can fail with `not a git repository`. Mutually exclusive with `template_name`, `template_project_id`.

Name of template from which to create project. Without `use_custom_template`, the name of a built-in project template. With `use_custom_template`, the name of a custom project template. Mutually exclusive with `import_url`, `template_project_id`.

Project ID of template from which to create project. Use with `use_custom_template` for a custom project template. Preferred over `template_name`, which can be ambiguous. Premium and Ultimate only. Mutually exclusive with `import_url`, `template_name`.
The Connection to use; default "default" in the same namespace.
Fill body fields from Secrets: {<field>: {name, key}}. Use for tokens, passwords and secret values.

Fill spec fields from other objects in this namespace: {<field>: {kind, name, fieldPath}}. fieldPath defaults to status.id, taken once that object is Ready; apiVersion is needed only where the kind's name is in more than one group. Nothing is sent until every reference resolves.

notes: `spec.namespace_id` is a number the live test takes from a value it saves first; replace the 0.
